author: Python_s_
text: ALERT — OpenSSH musl Authentication Bypass Draws Exploitation Attempts. CVE-2026-123158 | OpenSSH sshd. AFFECTED: Linux systems using musl libc without active PAM, with password authentication enabled.

author: slashdot
text: Chainalysis Says Breach Exposed Credentials For All Customers

author: LaeraWillmont
text: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card details, personal data and crypto wallet information. The crypto debit card provider said customer funds remained safe despite the exposure of sensitive financial and personal information.

author: Python_s_
text: ALERT — D-Link Investigates Switch Management Vulnerabilities. PRODUCT: DGS-3130-30TS hardware B1. Firmware examined: 2.00.B014, 2.00.B034, 2.04.000 and 2.04.001; researcher reproduced management-plane flaws.

author: ycnewsdigest
text: Claude Code has been quietly stuffing your account email into User-Agent headers on outbound requests — without asking. Result: users report dozens of daily phishing emails tied to sites they never visited. Anthropic shipped a privacy plugin in 2.1.317 and plans to remove emails from context.

author: theoutput_show
text: OpenAI says its new GPT-6 Cyber developed 948 Linux privilege escalation exploits and found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws. OpenAI rates it Critical in cybersecurity, up from High.

author: FBILasVegas
text: Industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems protect food, medicine, and other temperature-sensitive products, making them attractive targets. Joint warning with CISA, HHS, USDA, and DOT on cyberattacks against these systems.

author: blockiy_team
text: CVE-2026-98432 affects the Linux kernel — not cardano-node. Patch, reboot if required, then verify the running kernel. AI-discovered Linux flaw reports urge operators to confirm the patched kernel is actually running.

author: techhelpkb
text: OpenAI has revealed GPT-6 Cyber, a new AI model that discovered 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities and developed working exploits for 948 distinct Linux kernel flaws.

author: battista212
text: Also this week: CISA added a SonicWall SSLVPN flaw, CVE-2026-19868, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Federal agencies have a 72-hour remediation clock; all orgs should patch now.

author: AlchemyGrove
text: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers in what the company calls a multifront cyberattack. Per Ars Technica, the company says the attack involved AI agents and an on-path data snatch.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Desktop 4.98.0 strengthens security, fixes critical CVEs like API key exposures, and improves reliability for developers. Update now.

author: cynthiamyers03
text: If you hold a Gnosis Pay card: its legacy system was breached Nov 3. Exposed: card number, expiry, CVV, name, home address, wallet address. Funds untouched. Confirm the card is canceled; expect phishing using your address.

author: LinuxKodachi
text: Claude Code was leaking account email address in web searches and MCP user-agent header when websites asked it nicely.

author: PumpkinSecurity
text: AI agents are a bane for some website operators, says Cloudflare. Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince stated that nation-state actors and criminals likely exploited the PHP2SHELL vulnerability before its disclosure.

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-59104 · CRITICAL · CVSS 9.8 — UgCS server before 6.2 contains an authentication bypass in the HCI protocol login handler (LoginHandler) exposed on TCP port 3334.

author: cubillas888
text: AI agents reproduced a 1024-bit RSA oracle computation in 391 CPU core-years, vs 1,380 before, DeepMind says. Same Shea et al. instance and algorithm; two agents; about 20 human messages. Paper: 2048-bit and larger RSA not threatened.

author: mikejt4
text: Chainalysis updated their October incident again… Names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for *all* users were exposed. KYT and Address Screening are coming back in phases; every user has to reset passwords and rotate API keys.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: Attackers exploit the SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN flaw CVE-2026-19868 in the wild. Update Gen7 and Gen8 firewalls now to patch CVE-2026-107155 and 6 bugs.

author: cyberblog_
text: CVE-2026-98432: Linux IPv4 TCP use-after-free. Anthropic describes a research exploit aiming a listener MPTCP up to root. Patch kernels; verify versions; nftables workaround documented.

author: VeryCodedly
text: Researchers just disclosed sshole, a 10 year old OpenSSH flaw affecting Linux systems using musl libc without PAM (Alpine, mainly). A password of 257–1024 characters could bypass auth for accounts with an invalid password hash. Fixed in OpenSSH 10.6p2. CVE-2026-123158.

author: WhaleWireNews
text: JUST IN: Critical WordPress flaw CVE-2026-119977 allows remote code during updates; users must patch to 7.1.4+ immediately.

author: CrossAndCrowbar
text: OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber just found 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox bugs and built working exploits for 948 Linux privilege escalations, per OpenAI and BleepingComputer. Mozilla already shipping fixes.

author: lwcyber
text: An AI broke into Linux 948 times in 30 hours. Every exploit needs a foothold first, so patch on schedule and kill old accounts. GPT-6 Cyber / Linux kernel privilege escalations.

author: ycnewsdigest
text: Microsoft just dropped a CVE for MS Paint. Remote code execution. No user interaction. CVSS 8.1 (CVE-2026-83844). Network attack surface in Paint; fix via Microsoft Store Paint 11.2609.401.0+.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-19868 — HIGH — actively exploited per CISA KEV. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN. CVSS 7.5.

author: cvedotnow
text: SPH Engineering UgCS: authentication bypass in server HCI interface (CVE-2026-59104). Remote attacker can gain full access without logging in, then control connected drones. Patch → 6.2.

author: clawdtalk
text: WorkOS incident update: a security researcher evaluating ARTEX, an autonomous penetration-testing AI agent, inside what they believed was an isolated environment, accessed an internal sales tool. AI-agent escape / unauthorized access case.

author: Codezero_io
text: For about 11 hours this week, developers installing a popular AI coding extension got a backdoor instead. A trojanised Claude Code extension went out through Cursor's marketplace, able to plant persistent SSH backdoors on up to 5,000 developer machines.

author: busenur038
text: Barracuda's Nov. 5 update: CVE-2026-116606 needs no login if an ESG Admin UI is reachable. Chained with CVE-2026-111560, it can bypass authorization and reach root. CVSS 4.0: 9.3 + 8.6.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: A PHP session handling mismatch can lead to unauthenticated object injection and remote code execution; CVE-2026-115560. PoC published. Requires unusual session.serialize_handler settings.

author: Python_s_
text: ALERT — Beget Says VPS Backups May Be Available to Only Half of Customers After Destructive Cyberattack. PRODUCT: Beget VPS, S3 and Kubernetes cloud services. After checking surviving backup servers, Beget revised availability estimates.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: A GhostLock futex use-after-free can be used to gain root on the BlackBerry KEYone; CVE-2026-43499. PoC targets the Linux kernel futex vulnerability behind GhostLock.

author: Priosweep
text: CISA just added SonicWall CVE-2026-19868 to KEV: a SAML/MFA bypass in SonicOS SSLVPN, already exploited. Federal due date is Nov 20 (vendor advisory SNWLID-2026-0014).

author: LoopWireNews
text: Chainalysis Says Breach Exposed Credentials for Its Entire Customer Base. Attackers made off with login data and access tokens belonging to every customer it serves.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Critical · Patched. JupyterLab Desktop: XSS and one-click token-leak RCE (CVE-2026-102530 / CVE-2026-86044) plus macOS TCC bypasses — fixed in 4.6.2-1. CVE-2025-54991, CVE-2025-55002.

author: cvedotnow
text: Chartbrew: 4 critical CVEs. Worst: SQL injection in dashboard filter substitution (CVE-2026-54349).

author: DarkWebInformer
text: QNAP warns hackers are actively exploiting Plex2Shell vulnerabilities to breach NAS devices. Four vulnerabilities in Plex Media Server collectively known as Plex2Shell.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-123488 Craft CMS 4.0.0 before 4.18.9 and 5.0.0 before 5.11.2 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the element search endpoint.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-119923 A heap-based buffer overflow in the TDS prelogin parser in the Babelfish for PostgreSQL extension (and Amazon variants).
